stem.en: One floor of a building is about 3 m tall. A tsunami has a run-up height of 30 m. About how many floors high does the water climb?

explanation.en: 30 m ÷ 3 m = 10, so the water climbs as high as a building of about ten floors. Run-up can reach 30 m, or even more in extreme cases.

hints.en: How many times does 3 m go into 30 m?
